As a new patient, I emailed on Monday for my prescription as advised. I was told it would be at the pharmacy by Wednesday. It wasn’t. I called, they promised an “emergency request.” That didn’t happen either — shocking, I know.

When the prescription finally appeared, two of my heart medications were missing and won’t be in stock until Monday. Nothing like a five-day gap in essential meds to keep life interesting.
